title: Approved DSH Chat Plan is markdown, not structured tasks
content: DSH plan-mode persists the complete approved plan as the JSON `plan` argument of a successful `exit_plan_mode` tool call; its projection exposes only mode state. HUMAN selected deterministic import from checklist/bullet/numbered items inside `## Tasks`, merge-only-missing, fail closed otherwise.

title: Fresh ASC may report stale immediately after run start
content: run_aip.py start wrote a new Active Step Context containing current AIP content but marked staleness_status=stale with reason AIP modified after ASC was built. This appears to compare against the pre-write ASC timestamp. Consider computing freshness after successful rebuild.
